_what: FELID STRUCTURE INVENTORY (domain pack data): the parts that must exist AS STRUCTURE for a region to pass its layer - accuracy has two parts, numeric tolerances AND structural completeness (person, 2026-10-17: the ears lacked the outer-edge flap 'shown in every reference', the paws read as hooves, the nose and mouth were painted). A part passes only when it is VISIBLE IN A COLOURLESS CLAY render (skill E5) at close-up from front, three-quarter and side, and sits where the photo / references put it. 'refs' = files in cases/<case>/references (real photos) or engine/references/illustrations (AI cards, layout only).
